passage.label: Al-Baqarah — If traveling and no scribe then pledge; entrusted trustee must fulfill trust; do not conceal testimony; concealer is sinful heart; Allah knows what you do; everything in heavens/earth belongs to Allah; whether disclose or conceal Allah calls to account; Messenger believes in what was revealed; believers believe in Allah angels books messengers no distinction; we hear and obey; forgiveness sought; Allah does not burden soul beyond capacity; earns good for itself evil against itself; our Lord do not impose blame if forgotten/erred; do not burden as burdened those before; do not load what we cannot bear; pardon forgive have mercy; You are mawlana so grant victory over disbelieving people

arabicExcerpts.text: ۞وَإِن كُنتُمۡ عَلَىٰ سَفَرٖ وَلَمۡ تَجِدُواْ كَاتِبٗا فَرِهَٰنٞ مَّقۡبُوضَةٞۖ فَإِنۡ أَمِنَ بَعۡضُكُم بَعۡضٗا فَلۡيُؤَدِّ ٱلَّذِي ٱؤۡتُمِنَ أَمَٰنَتَهُۥ وَلۡيَتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ رَبَّهُۥۗ وَلَا تَكۡتُمُواْ ٱلشَّهَٰدَةَۚ وَمَن يَكۡتُمۡهَا فَإِنَّهُۥٓ ءَاثِمٞ قَلۡبُهُۥۗ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ عَلِيمٞ

لِّلَّهِ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۗ وَإِن تُبۡدُواْ مَا فِيٓ أَنفُسِكُمۡ أَوۡ تُخۡفُوهُ يُحَاسِبۡكُم بِهِ ٱللَّهُۖ فَيَغۡفِرُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيُعَذِّبُ مَن يَشَآءُۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٌ

ءَامَنَ ٱلرَّسُولُ بِمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيۡهِ مِن رَّبِّهِۦ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَۚ كُلٌّ ءَامَنَ بِٱللَّهِ وَمَلَـٰٓئِكَتِهِۦ وَكُتُبِهِۦ وَرُسُلِهِۦ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيۡنَ أَحَدٖ مِّن رُّسُلِهِۦۚ وَقَالُواْ سَمِعۡنَا وَأَطَعۡنَاۖ غُفۡرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيۡكَ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ

لَا يُكَلِّفُ ٱللَّهُ نَفۡسًا إِلَّا وُسۡعَهَاۚ لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتۡ وَعَلَيۡهَا مَا ٱكۡتَسَبَتۡۗ رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذۡنَآ إِن نَّسِينَآ أَوۡ أَخۡطَأۡنَاۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحۡمِلۡ عَلَيۡنَآ إِصۡرٗا كَمَا حَمَلۡتَهُۥ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِنَاۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلۡنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِۦۖ وَٱعۡفُ عَنَّا وَٱغۡفِرۡ لَنَا وَٱرۡحَمۡنَآۚ أَنتَ مَوۡلَىٰنَا فَٱنصُرۡنَا عَلَى ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ

mainSubject.label: Travel exception: pledge replaces written contract when scribe unavailable; amanah (trust) fulfillment obligation; testimony concealment prohibition with heart-sinfulness warning; universal divine ownership and accountability regardless of disclosure or concealment; prophetic-believer creedal affirmation: belief in Allah, angels, books, messengers without distinction; submission formula 'we hear and obey'; capacity principle reiterated (la yukallifu Allahu nafsan illa wus'aha); individual moral accounting; closing supplication: no blame for forgetfulness/error, no excessive burden, pardon-forgive-mercy triad, victory over disbelievers

subordinateSubjects.label: Travel pledge exception when no scribe available
Do not conceal testimony; concealer has sinful heart

Individual earning: good for self, evil against self
Supplication: no blame for nisyana (forgetfulness) or khata' (error)
Supplication: do not burden as those before us
Mawlana (our Protector): grant victory over kafirin

Total submission expressed through hearing-obeying formula

notes: Pass A pilot 12, passage 42/6. Concludes Surah Al-Baqarah with creedal summary, capacity principle, and comprehensive closing du'a. The sami'na wa ata'na formula (2:285) defines believer posture. Final du'a (2:286) among most recited supplications. Capacity principle echoes 2:233. Links to divine-mercy, repentance, accountability-responsibility, patience.
